purpose: Supplement the unchanged high-spp primary protocol with an early, explicitly noise-unbiased estimate of squared reconstruction bias. Primary high-spp targets are not relaxed or replaced.
trigger: First measured Seal physical reference costs 94.28s per 128 spp; its full 65536-spp target alone projects about 13.4 GPU hours. No neural-versus-reference MSE has been computed when this supplemental diagnostic is declared.
seed_bases: neural 210000+100000*rep; PT 410000+100000*rep as implemented in the primary wrapper. Cross-method seed overlap at different rep indices is possible; the estimator MUST use separate nonoverlapping seed streams below for NEW replicates, and must not assume independence of existing overlapping streams across methods.
new_seed_bases: neural 10000000+100000*rep; PT 20000000+100000*rep for NEW diagnostic-only outputs. Existing primary outputs are not reused in this estimator.
estimator: For paired independent residual images D_i=N_i-R_i, U=mean_RGBpixels(((sum_i D_i)^2-sum_i D_i^2)/(m*(m-1))). This estimates squared difference of expected linear images without positive reference-noise bias.
uncertainty: Leave-one-independent-replicate-out U-statistic jackknife standard error; report approximate t(m-1) 95% interval. Only eight independent pairs, so interval is diagnostic, not a certified exact-replication gate. Do not treat pairwise products as independent replicates.
metrics: Raw linear whole-image 100*U is primary. Display-transformed residual U is separately labelled; it estimates expected displayed finite-spp images, not the display of expected radiance, and cannot decide Table 1 reconstruction bias.
timing: Same 800-square native scenes, unmodified checkpoints, 4-spp chunks and warmup; wall timing and cold overhead separately retained.
interpretation: Numeric paper ratio with interval, no invented pass threshold. No retraining or training-time claim. High-spp primary convergence and unpublished evaluation-mapping limitations remain explicit.
